# Reviewed under AGENTS.md

import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Convert ``title`` into a URL-friendly slug."""
    slug = title.lower()
    slug = slug.replace('&', ' and ')
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 -]', '', slug)
    slug = re.sub(r'[ -]+', '-', slug)
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    if len(slug) > 40:
        slug = slug[:40].rstrip('-')
    return slug
